writeup: Santa Barbara Design Studio's 30-inch honeycomb paper tree (item P6582) in Frasier fir green with a warm white finish is new on Woot for $22.99. It pops open into a full tree with hidden magnets and folds flat for storage after the holidays. Wish Walnut Creek sells the same 30-inch tree for $54.95, and the brand's own store charges $67.50, so Woot is about 58% below the cheapest store we found.
